diagrams.purpose: Show the three user roles, the QSPARK web application and the SQLite data store, plus the optional browser camera.

elements.label: CUSTOMER
elements.description: Books parking, pays from wallet, presents QR

elements.label: ADMIN
elements.description: Operational staff: customers, slots, scanning, analytics

elements.label: SUPER_ADMIN
elements.description: Full system authority and system online/offline control

elements.label: Web Browser
elements.description: Renders Jinja2 pages and runs the QS/QSUI JavaScript

elements.label: QSPARK Flask Application
elements.description: Page routes, JSON APIs, session auth, CSRF, business logic

elements.label: Device Camera
elements.description: Optional getUserMedia stream for QR capture

layout_instructions: Place actors on the left, browser and application in the centre, database on the right.
Show the camera as an optional dashed connection to the browser.
Use directional arrows with readable labels.

Do not show Oracle or ORDS in the active context.

layout_instructions: Stack layers vertically: presentation, routing, API, domain, data.

diagrams.purpose: Show the end-to-end customer path including wallet and overtime decisions.

diagrams.diagram_title: Data Flow Diagram Level 1 - Booking and Settlement
diagrams.purpose: Decompose hold, confirm, cancel and exit into numbered processes and their stores.

elements.label: 1. Validate and hold
elements.description: Plate, window, slot, overlap and vehicle checks

layout_instructions: Number the processes 1 to 4.
Keep money stores on the lower right.
Label every flow with the record or amount it carries.

diagrams.purpose: Model all eleven tables with keys, principal attributes and cardinality.
layout_instructions: Place users, floors, vehicle_types, parking_slots and bookings in a central cluster.
Place money tables on the right and policy tables on the left.
Use crow-foot notation and label cardinality.
Show all eleven tables, not a subset.
accuracy_constraints: Use only the columns listed in schema.sql.
Mark PK, UQ and FK correctly.
Do not add customer, admin, wallet, vehicle or payment tables.
Keep the mandatory audit columns visible.

diagrams.purpose: Show the five booking states and the only legal transitions.
layout_instructions: Place HELD on the left and CONFIRMED to its right.
Place COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED as terminal states on the right and bottom.
Show no outgoing transitions from terminal states.
accuracy_constraints: Only these eight transitions are legal.
Do not add a REFUNDED or ENTERED state.
Do not allow CONFIRMED to EXPIRED.
